summary: CACHE_SEMANTIC — 비슷한 질문이 1시간 안에 있었음. Claude 호출 0, 슬롯 값(20시)만 새로 넣어 스냅샷에서 다시 실행

value.sql: SELECT m.title AS movie_title, t.name AS theater_name, s.auditorium_name, s.starts_at, s.remaining_seats FROM screening s JOIN movie m ON m.movie_id = s.movie_id JOIN theater t ON t.theater_id = s.theater_id WHERE s.business_date = '2026-11-17' AND s.start_hour >= 20 AND s.starts_at > '2026-11-17 19:42' ORDER BY s.starts_at LIMIT 500
